overview: A comprehensive Student Portal with personalized dashboard, study notes library, placement job listings, internship opportunities, student profile, and admin management panel. Built with Motoko backend and React/TypeScript/Tailwind frontend with Internet Identity authentication.
features: Student dashboard with profile card and quick-access tiles
Study notes library organized by subject with PDF downloads
Placement job listings with urgency badges and PDF downloads
Internship listings with filters, stipend info, and application links
Read-only student profile with academic and contact details
Admin panel for managing notes, placements, and internships with file uploads
Responsive sidebar navigation with mobile hamburger menu
Sample content seeded in backend for all sections
